    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Album
    JPA entity representing a music album.
    AlbumRepository
    Spring Data JPA repository for Album entities.
    AllTimeStatsData
    Data transfer object holding pre-computed all-time listening statistics for the dashboard graph info panel.
    AnalyticsCacheService
    In-memory cache for analytics DoublyLinkedList datasets, shared by all users of the web application and scoped per user.
    AnalyticsController
    Serves the "My Reports" (analytics) page and the JSON endpoints behind its "view all" modals.
    AnalyticsController.AlbumItem
    A top-albums row.
    AnalyticsController.ArtistItem
    A top-artists row.
    AnalyticsController.Bar
    One bar of the wrapped monthly chart.
    AnalyticsController.CalendarCell
    One cell of the weekly calendar grid.
    AnalyticsController.CalendarView
    The weekly calendar for one month.
    AnalyticsController.HistoryItem
    A listening-history row.
    AnalyticsController.MonthButton
    One monthly selector button.
    AnalyticsController.NavEntry
    One entry of the analytics sidebar.
    AnalyticsController.PageResult<T>
    A page of rows returned by the paginated JSON endpoints.
    AnalyticsController.RankRow
    One row of a wrapped top-5 list.
    AnalyticsController.ReportCard
    The data of one weekly or monthly report card.
    AnalyticsController.SongItem
    A top-songs row.
    AppAuthenticationProvider
    Spring Security AuthenticationProvider that delegates to AuthenticationService.
    AppUserPrincipal
    Immutable identity of a logged-in user, stored in the Spring Security context.
    AppUtils
    Shared utility methods used across the web edition.
    Artist
    JPA entity representing a music artist.
    ArtistListeningTimeService
    Computes total listening time per artist from the current user's playback history.
    ArtistListeningTimeService.ArtistTimeData
    Pairs an Artist with their total accumulated listening time in seconds.
    ArtistRepository
    Spring Data JPA repository for Artist entities.
    ArtistUtils
    Utility class for resolving artist display names from Song entities.
    AuthenticationController
    Web controller for the sign-in and create-account page.
    AuthenticationService
    Handles user registration and authentication.
    ChartData
    Data transfer object carrying the three monthly listening time series (current year, previous year, all-time highest year) needed to render the dashboard line chart and its colour-coded title row.
    ChartViewModel
    Builds the data series for the dashboard line chart.
    DailyListeningStatsService
    Provides daily and weekly listening statistics for the dashboard stat cards.
    DashboardController
    Serves the My Dashboard page and the JSON endpoints that refresh its panels.
    DashboardController.AllTimeStatsJson
    The all-time statistics shown beside the chart.
    DashboardController.ChartJson
    The chart payload: series, year metadata and the all-time stats for the selected year.
    DashboardController.ChartSeries
    One line of the chart.
    DashboardController.RecentRow
    One Recently Played row.
    DashboardController.StatCardsJson
    The five dashboard stat cards.
    DashboardController.StatLabel
    One clickable stat-card label (a top song or a top album).
    DashboardController.TopArtistRow
    One Top Artists row.
    DoublyLinkedList<T>
    Generic DoublyLinkedList data structure for pagination.
    ExtractedSongMetadata
    Everything read from one audio file in a single pass by SongMetadataExtractor.
    Favourite
    JPA entity recording a song that a user has marked as a favourite.
    FavouriteRepository
    Spring Data JPA repository for Favourite entities.
    FavouriteService
    Manages the current user's favourited songs.
    Genre
    JPA entity representing a music genre.
    GenreFilterService
    GenreFilterService provides filtering logic for songs and albums by genre.
    GenreRepository
    Spring Data JPA repository for Genre entities.
    GlobalModelAdvice
    Adds model attributes that every Thymeleaf template can use.
    HistoryRowData
    Display DTO representing a single row in the Listening History view.
    ImportController
    Web entry point for all import functionality (the desktop "Import Music" screen).
    ImportController.JobStarted
    Response of the endpoints that start an import.
    ImportController.JobStatus
    Progress of an import job.
    ImportController.ResultRow
    One row of the results table.
    ImportController.ScanRequest
    Body of POST /api/import/scan.
    ImportJobRegistry
    In-memory registry of import jobs so the browser can poll the progress of a running import.
    ImportJobRegistry.Job
    Mutable job state shared between the pipeline thread (writer) and request threads (readers).
    ImportJobRegistry.JobSnapshot
    Read-only view of a job returned to the browser.
    ImportJobRegistry.State
    Lifecycle of a job.
    ImportOrchestrator
    Single source-of-truth entry point for the import pipeline.
    ImportOrchestrator.ImportCallbacks
    All UI notification points for a single import run.
    LastFmAlbumRef
    Raw album reference as returned inside a Last.fm scrobble.
    LastFmArtistRef
    Raw artist reference as returned inside a Last.fm scrobble.
    LastFmScrobble
    One scrobble entry from Last.fm's user.getRecentTracks response, flattened from the raw JSON (see recenttracks[].track[]) into a single record per play.
    LibraryService
    Thin facade for song, album, and artist retrieval.
    LibraryState
    Immutable per-request view state of the My Library page, built from the query string.
    ListeningHistoryService
    Service for managing user listening history with pagination support.
    ListeningHistoryViewModel
    Builds paginated listening history rows for the Analytics page.
    ListeningPaginationService
    Pagination service for analytics listings (songs, artists, albums).
    LoginAttemptService
    Tracks failed login attempts per username and enforces escalating lockout periods to protect against brute force attacks.
    MainController
    Entry-point controller of the web application.
    MediaController
    Streams song audio files and album cover images from disk to the browser.
    MigrationResult
    Carries the outcome of a single file evaluated during import.
    MigrationResult.Status
    The possible outcomes for a single file during import.
    MonthlyReport
    JPA entity that persists a pre-computed monthly listening summary for one user.
    MonthlyReportData
    Display record holding the pre-formatted data for a single monthly report card.
    MonthlyReportRepository
    Spring Data JPA repository for MonthlyReport entities.
    MonthlyReportService
    Generates and persists monthly listening reports for the current user.
    MonthlyReportViewModel
    Builds monthly report data for a given year and month.
    MusicDashboardApplication
    Spring Boot application entry point for the web edition.
    MusicPlayerService
    Server-side playback state for one logged-in browser session: queue, current song and tracking flags.
    MusicPlayerService.PreviousResult
    Result of MusicPlayerService.playPrevious(Double).
    MyLibraryController
    Serves the My Library page (GET /library) and its JSON endpoints under /api/library/.
    MyLibraryController.AlbumDetail
    The album detail page model.
    MyLibraryController.AlbumEditRequest
    Request body of PUT /api/library/albums/{id} (the AlbumEditDialog.Result).
    MyLibraryController.AlbumItem
    An album as shown in cards, rows and the edit dialog.
    MyLibraryController.ArtistItem
    An artist row of the Artists tab.
    MyLibraryController.Group<T>
    A section of an alphabetically grouped list.
    MyLibraryController.SongDetails
    Details of one song as needed by the edit dialog and the context menu.
    MyLibraryController.SongEditRequest
    Request body of PUT /api/library/songs/{id} (the SongEditDialog fields).
    MyLibraryController.SongItem
    A song as shown in list rows, grid cards and album detail rows.
    PlaybackAggregator
    Utility class that aggregates PlaybackHistory records into report-ready values.
    PlaybackConstants
    Centralized constants for playback tracking and validation.
    PlaybackHistory
    JPA entity recording a single playback event.
    PlaybackHistoryRepository
    Spring Data JPA repository for PlaybackHistory entities.
    PlaybackTrackingService
    Records listening history rows and later completes them with the played duration.
    PlayerController
    JSON API through which the browser player talks to the per-session MusicPlayerService.
    PlayerController.EndedRequest
    Request body of POST /api/player/ended.
    PlayerController.PlayerState
    Player state returned by the endpoints.
    PlayerController.PlayRequest
    Request body of POST /api/player/play.
    PlayerController.PositionRequest
    Request body of next and previous.
    PlayerController.QueueRequest
    Request body of POST /api/player/queue.
    PlayerController.SongView
    JSON view of a song for the player UI.
    Playlist
    JPA entity representing a user-created playlist.
    PlaylistController
    Serves the Playlist page and the JSON endpoints used by it and by the library page.
    PlaylistController.PlaylistForm
    Body of the create and rename requests.
    PlaylistController.PlaylistSummary
    Summary returned by the playlist JSON endpoints.
    PlaylistController.PlaylistView
    One playlist as shown in the playlist browser (card or row) and in the selected header.
    PlaylistController.SongView
    One song row or card inside the selected playlist.
    PlaylistRepository
    Spring Data JPA repository for Playlist entities.
    PlaylistService
    Time Complexity: Create/delete: O(1) single database operation Add/remove song: O(1) list manipulation in memory Get playlists: O(n) where n = user's playlists Space Complexity: O(n) where n = playlist size (songs in playlist)
    SecurityConfig
    Spring Security configuration for the web application.
    SettingsController
    Serves the Settings page.
    Song
    JPA entity representing a music track.
    SongImportService
    Read-side accessor for the song library.
    SongMetadataExtractor
    Reads an audio file's tag and header data exactly once and returns a fully-populated ExtractedSongMetadata.
    SongRepository
    Spring Data JPA repository for Song entities.
    SongUpdateService
    The single class responsible for turning ExtractedSongMetadata into database state.
    SortStrategy
    Defines sorting strategies for songs and albums used across the library views.
    StatCardsData
    Display DTO for the five dashboard stat cards.
    StatCardsViewModel
    ViewModel for the dashboard stat cards.
    StatSnapshot
    All stat-card values derived from a single database fetch.
    SyncQueueEntry
    JPA entity for the offline action queue.
    SyncQueueRepository
    Spring Data JPA repository for SyncQueueEntry entities.
    TopAlbumRowData
    Display DTO representing a single row in the Top Albums analytics view.
    TopAlbumsViewModel
    Builds paginated top album rows for the Analytics page.
    TopArtistRowData
    Display DTO representing a single row in the Top Artists analytics view.
    TopArtistsViewModel
    ViewModel for artist-related analytics views.
    TopSongRowData
    Display DTO representing a single row in the Top Songs analytics view.
    TopSongsViewModel
    Builds paginated top song rows for the Analytics page.
    User
    JPA entity representing an application user.
    UserRepository
    Spring Data JPA repository for User entities.
    UserSessionService
    Resolves the current request's logged-in user from the Spring Security context.
    WeeklyReport
    JPA entity that persists a pre-computed weekly listening summary for one user.
    WeeklyReportData
    Display record holding the pre-formatted data for a single weekly report card.
    WeeklyReportRepository
    Spring Data JPA repository for WeeklyReport entities.
    WeeklyReportService
    Generates and persists weekly listening reports for the current user.
    WeeklyReportViewModel
    Builds weekly report data for a given year and ISO week number.
    YearEndReport

    YearEndReportRepository

    YearEndReportViewModel
